text:
Nora (Content): Quick proposal: run a 2-week micro-launch: 1 OSS refapp repo + 3 how-tos + a short benchmark post + gated 20-min webinar. Goal: community momentum and leads.
Diego (DevRel): I can own the refapp + runnable perf script. Plan: single repo with examples/quickstart/embed/cost-tune.
Lin (Growth): I'll set up Typeform -> webhook -> HubSpot. Keep gating email-only. UTMs: source=community, campaign=refapp_micro_v1.
Maya (Design): I can make hero + 3 tutorial thumbnails + a GIF demo. Need final copy by Tue noon.
Sven (Ops): I'll create a Zapier catch hook and run staging tests. Also advise a simple spam check on Typeform.
Nora (Content): Tutorial topics: quickstart (text gen), embeddings for search, batching & KV-cache tuning. Each ~400-600 words + one small demo.
Diego (DevRel): I'll add CONTRIBUTING and a tiny badge for contributors. CLI to start: `npx redwood-refapp init --example micro`.
Lin (Growth): Lead flow: immediate thank-you with quickstart, day 3 benchmark highlight, day 7 webinar invite. I'll share mapping sheet.
Maya (Design): Tone: pragmatic with a small playful line. Deliver assets Wed AM.
Sven (Ops): Zapier test curl (staging):
```
curl -X POST https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/55555/aaaaa -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"qa@redwood.com","utm_campaign":"refapp_micro_v1"}'
```
EventBot: Webhook test received and forwarded to HubSpot staging.
Nora (Content): Benchmark post should be short (500-700 w): show median vs tuned, p95, tokens/sec, cost/token and one recommended config. Include a CSV export for charts.
Diego (DevRel): I'll push repo scaffold and harness CSV. ETA first drafts in 7 days.
Lin (Growth): CTA variants A/B: "Try the refapp" vs "Preview the demo". Decision by Fri.
Nora (Content): Owners: Refapp & code: Diego. Copy + benchmark: Nora. Routing + nurture: Lin. Design: Maya. Ops: Sven. Check-in Thurs. :rocket:
